content.title: IPL 2026 Points Table: Latest standings after PBKS down CSK
content.text: Punjab Kings’ thrilling chase against CSK reshuffles the IPL 2026 standings as teams jostle for early momentum. Punjab Kings’ Marcus Stoinis celebrates after PBKS beat CSK in Chennai on April 3, 2026. (PTI Photo/R Senthilkumar)Punjab Kings delivered a statement performance in Chennai, chasing down a daunting 210-run target against Chennai Super Kings to secure a five-wicket victory and strengthen their position in the IPL 2026 points table. Leading from the front, skipper Shreyas Iyer anchored the chase with a fluent half-century that combined control with calculated aggression.ADVERTISEMENTAlso Read Walking in during a crucial phase, Shreyas initially took time to settle before accelerating with authority, particularly against spin. His ability to find boundaries under pressure ensured Punjab stayed ahead of the required rate in what was a demanding chase. However, the foundation of the victory was laid much earlier by Punjab’s explosive top order. Priyansh Arya set the tone with a blistering cameo, taking on the CSK pacers with fearless strokeplay. His aggressive intent in the powerplay, alongside Prabhsimran Singh, allowed Punjab to race ahead and keep the pressure firmly on the hosts. Prabhsimran then carried the momentum forward with a composed innings, rotating strike effectively while capitalising on loose deliveries. The early partnership ensured Punjab remained in control of the chase despite the high target. Check out the points table below: The updated IPL points table as of April 4, 2026. Credit: https://www.iplt20.com/Cooper Connolly’s contribution in the middle overs proved equally crucial. The young batter maintained the tempo and built a valuable partnership with Shreyas, allowing the innings to stabilise after early breakthroughs. Their stand ensured that Punjab never lost sight of the required rate. Even as wickets fell in the latter stages, Nehal Wadhera’s brief but impactful presence helped Punjab cross the finish line without letting the game drift. Despite a couple of quick dismissals that briefly raised hopes for CSK, the visitors held their nerve to complete the chase. Earlier in the evening, Chennai Super Kings had posted an imposing total on the back of a standout knock from young Ayush Mhatre. The teenager showcased maturity beyond his years, mixing timing with power to dominate the Punjab bowlers. His innings formed the backbone of CSK’s total. Ruturaj Gaikwad supported him with a steady knock, and the duo stitched together a crucial partnership that set up the innings. Later, contributions from Sarfaraz Khan and Shivam Dube added impetus in the death overs, pushing CSK past the 200-run mark. However, despite posting a competitive total, CSK’s bowlers struggled to contain Punjab’s aggressive batting approach. With this win, Punjab Kings registered their second consecutive victory, while CSK were left searching for answers after another defeat.
